# Velmora Manager — Full Customization and Career Asset Library

This is the backward-compatible system expansion of the complete manager pack.

- 176 hairstyles, 128 legacy-compatible face bases, 40 facial-hair styles and 200 outfits
- 16 modular eye shapes with 16 eye-colour palettes and 24 palette-swappable eyebrow shapes
- 32 complexion/detail overlays, 24 makeup options and 8 visual-age overlays
- 12 scene expressions, 24 jewellery options and 16 universal hair accessories
- 16 club-branding colour masks and 16 career reward layers
- 8 scene-specific wardrobe presets, 9 controlled randomization profiles, pronouns and titles
- 796 stable selectable IDs and 1,101 validated transparent modular layer PNGs

All established IDs and legacy face paths remain available. New integrations should follow `IMPLEMENTATION_PROMPT.md` and schema v5 in `manager-assets.json`.

Modern athletic pieces are deliberately team-neutral and trademark-safe: no real-world sportswear names or logos are embedded. Club branding is applied at runtime through indexed colour masks.

Validation: **PASS**.
